You can't reach your opponent!"},{"statement":"Otherwise, a Jab flips one of the opponent's Guard cards from ready to exhausted.","sourceSentence":"If not: Flip one of your opponent's Guard cards from ready to exhausted.","numericValue":{"magnitude":1,"unit":"Guard card","approximate":false}},{"statement":"If all of the opponent's Guard cards are already exhausted, the Jab does nothing.","sourceSentence":"If all their Guard cards are already exhausted, do nothing."},{"statement":"A Jab can never break a Guard card.","sourceSentence":"A Jab cannot break a Guard card (see Punch)."},{"statement":"The Retreat action card has a timing value of 2.","sourceSentence":"p.2, RETREAT (TIMING: 2), italic:","numericValue":{"magnitude":2,"unit":"timing","approximate":false}},{"statement":"If you are already in your corner, Retreat does nothing.","sourceSentence":"If you are already in your corner: Do nothing. You're already against the ropes!"},{"statement":"If you are in the center ring, Retreat moves your boxer to your corner.","sourceSentence":"If you are in the center ring: Move your boxer to your corner."},{"statement":"The Advance action card has a timing value of 3.","sourceSentence":"p.2, ADVANCE (TIMING: 3), italic:","numericValue":{"magnitude":3,"unit":"timing","approximate":false}},{"statement":"Advance does nothing if you are already in the center ring, or if your opponent also plays an Advance for the same action.","sourceSentence":"If you are already in the center ring and/or your opponent also plays an Advance card for the same action: Do nothing. You're just butting heads!"},{"statement":"Otherwise, Advance moves your boxer to the center ring, and if the opponent is in the center ring they are pushed into their corner.","sourceSentence":"If not: Move your boxer to the center ring. If your opponent is in the center ring, also push them into their corner."},{"statement":"Worked example: with Blue in their corner and Red in the center ring, Blue's Advance moves Blue to the center ring and pushes Red back to Red's own corner.","sourceSentence":"For example, Blue is in their corner and Red is in the center ring. Blue moves into the center ring, and Red is pushed back into their own corner."},{"statement":"The Block action card has a timing value of 4.","sourceSentence":"p.2, BLOCK (TIMING: 4), italic:","numericValue":{"magnitude":4,"unit":"timing","approximate":false}},{"statement":"If the opponent plays a Punch card for the same action, Block causes that Punch's effect on you to be ignored.","sourceSentence":"If your opponent plays a Punch card for the same action: Ignore any effect their Punch has on you (see Punch)."},{"statement":"Block does not stop Jabs.","sourceSentence":"Block actions do not block Jabs."},{"statement":"If the opponent does not play a Punch for the same action, Block does nothing.","sourceSentence":"If not: Do nothing."},{"statement":"The Punch action card has a timing value of 5.","sourceSentence":"p.2, PUNCH (TIMING: 5), italic:","numericValue":{"magnitude":5,"unit":"timing","approximate":false}},{"statement":"Punching from your corner requires you to flip one of your own Guard cards from ready to exhausted before resolving the Punch.","sourceSentence":"If you are in your corner: Flip one of your Guard cards from ready to exhausted, then resolve your Punch.","numericValue":{"magnitude":1,"unit":"Guard card","approximate":false}},{"statement":"If you are in your corner and have no ready Guard cards, your Punch does nothing.","sourceSentence":"If you do not have any ready Guard cards, do nothing. You're up against the ropes!"},{"statement":"Punching from the center ring resolves without flipping any of your own Guard cards.","sourceSentence":"If you are in the center ring: Resolve your Punch without flipping your Guard card. You've got 'em on the ropes!"},{"statement":"A Punch that is blocked, or thrown while both boxers are in their own corners, has no effect on the opponent, but you must still exhaust your own Guard card if you are in your corner.","sourceSentence":"If your Punch is blocked (see Block) or both you and your opponent are in your respective corners: Your Punch has no effect on your opponent; however, you must still exhaust your own guard card if you are in your corner."},{"statement":"An unblocked Punch against an opponent who has at least one exhausted Guard card breaks one of those exhausted Guard cards, removing it from the game and returning it to the box.","sourceSentence":"If your Punch is not blocked and your opponent has at least one exhausted Guard card: Break one of your opponent's exhausted Guard cards by removing it from the game and returning it to the box.","numericValue":{"magnitude":1,"unit":"Guard card","approximate":false}},{"statement":"An unblocked Punch against an opponent with no exhausted Guard cards instead flips one of their Guard cards from ready to exhausted.","sourceSentence":"If your Punch is not blocked and your opponent does not have any exhausted Guard cards: Instead of breaking their Guard, flip one of your opponent's Guard cards from ready to exhausted.","numericValue":{"magnitude":1,"unit":"Guard card","approximate":false}},{"statement":"When both players Punch on the same action and one is in the center ring, the player punching from their corner must finish exhausting a Guard card (if able) before either Punch resolves.","sourceSentence":"If both you and your opponent play a Punch for the same action while one player is in the center ring: The player punching from their corner must finish exhausting their Guard card (if able) before either player may resolve their Punch."},{"statement":"Worked example: Blue in their corner and Red in the center both Punch — Blue exhausts a Guard first, then both Punches resolve.","sourceSentence":"For example, if Blue is in their corner and Red is in the center and they both Punch, Blue must first exhaust a Guard before both players Punch one another."},{"statement":"The Rest action card has a timing value of 6.","sourceSentence":"p.2, REST (TIMING: 6), italic:","numericValue":{"magnitude":6,"unit":"timing","approximate":false}},{"statement":"Rest returns all action cards in your discard pile to your hand.","sourceSentence":"Reclaim your discards: Take all the action cards in your discard pile and add them to your hand."},{"statement":"Rest does not reclaim action cards currently in play.","sourceSentence":"Do not take any of the action cards currently in play."},{"statement":"If you have any exhausted Guard cards, Rest also flips one of them back to ready, in addition to reclaiming discards.","sourceSentence":"If any of your Guard cards are EXHAUSTED: Flip one Guard card back to ready. This is in addition to reclaiming your discards.","numericValue":{"magnitude":1,"unit":"Guard card","approximate":false}},{"statement":"After resolving the first action cards, they are not discarded; they stay in place while the second action cards are flipped face up and resolved the same way.","sourceSentence":"When you are done comparing and resolving the first action cards, DO NOT discard them yet. Leave them in place and flip the second action cards face up. Then, compare and resolve the second action cards just like you did with the first action cards."},{"statement":"Example: being punched while holding one ready and two exhausted Guards costs you one exhausted Guard.","sourceSentence":"If you are punched and have one ready and two exhausted Guards, you would lose one exhausted Guard."},{"statement":"Example: being punched while holding three ready and no exhausted Guards exhausts one card, leaving one exhausted and two ready.","sourceSentence":"If instead, you have three ready and no exhausted Guards, you would simply exhaust one card, leaving you with one exhausted and two ready."},{"statement":"In the Discard phase, after both sets of action cards have been compared and resolved, the two action cards played that round go to your discard pile and a new round begins.","sourceSentence":"After you have compared and resolved both the first and second sets of action cards, place your two action cards played this round into your discard pile, and then begin a new round.","numericValue":{"magnitude":2,"unit":"action cards","approximate":false}},{"statement":"No cards may be discarded before the Discard phase.","sourceSentence":"DO NOT DISCARD ANY CARDS UNTIL THIS PHASE."},{"statement":"Breaking all 3 of the opponent's Guard cards is a knockout and wins the game immediately.","sourceSentence":"Once a player has broken all 3 of their opponent's Guard cards, they have knocked them out and immediately win the game!","numericValue":{"magnitude":3,"unit":"Guard cards","approximate":false}},{"statement":"If both players knock each other out during the same action, the game is a draw.","sourceSentence":"If both players manage to knock each other out during the same action, it is a draw."},{"statement":"Holding both Rest cards in hand at once indicates a mistake: you picked up the current round's action cards while Resting; only discard-pile cards should be reclaimed.","sourceSentence":"You should never have both rest cards in your hand at the same time. If you do, you likely accidentally picked up your current action cards while Resting. When Resting, only pick up the cards currently in your discard pile and not the two action cards from that round."},{"statement":"You may play a Punch from your corner with no ready Guard card; it simply has no effect and does not force you to break your own Guard card.","sourceSentence":"If you are in your corner, you need a ready Guard card for a Punch to work; however, you may still choose to play a Punch card but it won't have any effect. This would not force you to break your own Guard card."},{"statement":"Game state can change mid-round — e.g. an opponent's Jab exhausting your last ready Guard leaves you with no Guard to exhaust for your corner Punch.","sourceSentence":"The state of the game may change in the middle of a round. For example, if your opponent Jabs and exhausts your last ready Guard just as you are attempting to Punch from your corner, you will no longer have a Guard card to exhaust."},{"statement":"During the plan phase, action cards may be placed in any order regardless of their timing numbers; timing is irrelevant in that phase (e.g. Rest first, Jab second).","sourceSentence":"In the plan phase, you may place any action cards, regardless of their timings, in any order. The timing on the cards does not matter in this phase. For example, you can play a Rest (timing 6) as your first action and a Jab (timing 1) as your second action."},{"statement":"In the fight phase, the first set of action cards fully resolves before the second set, so a first-action Block cannot stop a second-action Punch.","sourceSentence":"In the fight phase, the first set of action cards are always completely resolved before the second set of action cards. For example, a Block from the first action will not stop a Punch from the second action."},{"statement":"Game content is copyright 2020 Alright Games, all rights reserved, and may not be reproduced without specific permission.","sourceSentence":"All game content is © 2020 Alright Games, all rights reserved.
